1.label: Incoming Call
1.voicePrompt: Welcome to the VoicePay automated payment system. Please hold while we identify you.

2.label: Authentication
2.voicePrompt: To ensure your security, we are verifying the phone number you are calling from.

3.label: Payment Inquiry
3.voicePrompt: We have detected a pending invoice of one hundred and fifty euros. Press one to proceed with secure card payment, or press two if you prefer to be assisted by an agent.

4.label: User Selection
4.voicePrompt: Waiting for your selection. Dial one to pay, or two for support.

5.label: Payment Status
5.voicePrompt: Your payment of one hundred and fifty euros has been successfully processed and approved. Thank you very much for using VoicePay. Goodbye.

6.label: Agent Transfer
6.voicePrompt: We are transferring your call to the next available agent. Please hold.
